customManagers.description: The supervisor ref the validate task fetches schemas from (mise.toml [vars].supervisor_ref; see .mise/tasks/validate.py). Tracks home-assistant/supervisor GitHub releases: validating against the newest release keeps the app configs ahead of the installed fleet (stable-channel rollout lags releases). PRs automerge once the CI check job is green - green means the new schemas validate our app configs.

packageRules.description: Alpine apk pins in app Dockerfiles (e.g. hd-idle=1.22-r8): read the apk datasource's versions from the Alpine binary repositories and bump the app's config.yaml version in the same PR (experimental bumpVersions feature; patch bump - the dependency update is a fix-level change). Renovate cannot infer the branch from the base-image ARG default - without registryUrls it silently skips these pins (skipReason unknown-registry) - so the branch is pinned here; update it together with the Dockerfile BUILD_FROM default on a base-image bump (the validate.py drift check derives the branch dynamically and cross-checks the pins either way). No automerge: the changelog entry for the new version is still missing - it is completed manually before the merge (the hosted Renovate app cannot run post-upgrade tasks, so the templated changelog insertion would need a self-hosted instance or an own workflow).
GitHub Actions: weekly, like Dependabot did
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.

Supervisor schema pin: weekly, same cadence as the actions manager; automerges once the CI check job (mise run validate against the new ref) is green. The Renovate PR body lists the upstream changelog for an audit trail. automergeStrategy rebase: linear history without merge bubbles (GitHub rebase-merge; conflicts block the automerge until resolved — same as manual). Applies on both merge paths (Renovate's own merge today, platform-native automerge if branch protection ever arrives).
